Image generation uses the `hoi4_imagegen` MCP (`hoi4.image_*`): see the `hoi4-imagegen` skill and `references/imagegen-route.md` of `chaos-redux-event-assets`. The `gptimage` MCP and that skill's route section are the fallback. Transparent output is the default for every asset family whose unused canvas is transparent in the inspected HOI4 consumer, including icons, counters, emblems, overlays, decorative UI pieces, and transparent animation frames. Request a real transparent background in the initial prompt, verify the alpha channel of the saved PNG because the tool has no alpha parameter, and preserve it through processing, frame assembly, resizing, and DDS conversion. Background removal is a fallback only for output without usable alpha or an inherited, sourced, or user-provided image with an unwanted opaque backdrop; record the fallback and validate the repaired edges. Full-canvas scene art, flags, portraits, and painted panels keep the background treatment required by their actual consumer and reference family.

Image generation uses the `hoi4_imagegen` MCP (`hoi4.image_*`): see the `hoi4-imagegen` skill and `references/imagegen-route.md` of `chaos-redux-event-assets`. Native ImageGen is the fallback. Native ImageGen transparency is the default for every asset family whose unused canvas is transparent in the inspected HOI4 consumer, including icons, counters, emblems, overlays, decorative UI pieces, and transparent animation frames. Request a real transparent background in the initial ImageGen call and preserve the alpha channel through processing, frame assembly, resizing, and DDS conversion. Background removal is a fallback only for failed native-alpha output or an inherited, sourced, or user-provided image with an unwanted opaque backdrop; record the fallback and validate the repaired edges. Full-canvas scene art, flags, portraits, and painted panels keep the background treatment required by their actual consumer and reference family.

Route every character portrait to `chaosx_portrait_creator`. It finds and archives attributed sources for grounded subjects, wires source placeholders, and installs the HOI4-style final the user supplies; agents never operate RunPod. For fictional or impossible subjects it generates the portrait through the image-generation MCP workflow and completes processing, DDS conversion, wiring, manifest evidence, and handoff itself.
